description: The City of Münster's green space office looks after more than 960 hectares of municipal green, and this dataset gives the outline of each municipal green area with its category ('Objektart'): public green space, playground, cycle and walking path, riding path, compensation area, traffic green, school, kindergarten, other areas and new areas. Coverage: the city of Münster. Access: free CSV, WFS, WMS, KML, shapefile and GeoJSON downloads on the city open data portal (published August 2020, adjusted 18 September 2026); the portal tags it under heat and UV protection. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0. Caveats: only land managed by the municipal green office is included, and categories are administrative. Simulation uses: urban heat and cooling-space analysis, stormwater retention potential and maintenance workload models. Related records: the Berlin public green spaces layer and the Hamburg digital green plan.
